scope: Native Windows Chromium IndexedDB v4-to-v5, connection liveness, atomic references/deletion and malformed-state refusal; synthetic local data, no actual disk exhaustion/phone/GPU acceptance

checks.name: actual previous v4 journal reads the seeded immutable documents
native v4-to-v5 retains original document bytes/revisions, frozen task body/idempotency and budget
actual previous v4 functions are fenced after v5 without downgrade
controlled reference-only originals are protected by recoverable trash in document transaction
duplicate controlled key cannot overwrite committed original bytes
saving a new missing original reference aborts without changing document
live editor prevents deletion of an unreferenced file, including unsaved work
native marker upgrade reports occupied and leaves original bytes intact
closing actual editor page lets pending native probe confirm connection release without timer
mixed referenced/unreferenced deletion aborts entire batch
explicit deletion removes only unreferenced controlled original in one transaction
reload stale claim is reclaimed by native proof; explicit leave fences further old-page writes
missing marker stays uncertain and no marker database is created
unknown task version conservatively blocks cleanup
concurrent cleaners serialize; stale second delete refuses without partial deletion
new-editor registration versus deletion race leaves no saved dangling reference
unknown v4 store layout aborts upgrade and preserves version
blocked journal upgrade reports refusal; abandoned late upgrade does not mutate v4
